Find Your Edge

We are Zadara ~ a leading provider of AI edge clouds, delivering a groundbreaking distributed cloud platform purpose-built for sovereign AI applications. We are looking for authentic, driven, customer focused individuals to join our thriving global team.

Your Next Career Starts Here

Connect, Collaborate & Thrive With Us

WE CONNECT

Zadarians form genuine connections and share laughter, ensuring that everyone, whether in the office or working remotely, feels included in our Zadarian culture. We celebrate each other’s Z Stellar achievements, big and small, and show appreciation in meaningful ways. We create space to be well with Z Well, prioritizing both our minds and our bodies so we can thrive. Beyond our work, all of Zadara’s Hearts & Hands give back, creating a positive impact in the communities where we live and work. Because at the heart of it all, we’re more than colleagues – we’re a global community.

WE COLLABORATE

Zadarians collaborate and cultivate a one-team culture where diverse ideas come together to innovate. We appreciate curious, sharp-minded individuals who ask insightful questions, challenge the status quo, and contribute a wealth of diverse perspectives and insights.

WE THRIVE

Zadarians thrive in a positive mindset, embracing opportunities, building relationships and valuing the richness that comes from a vibrant mix of team members – driving collaboration, fueling innovation, and shaping who we are.

“WHERE AI DRIVES PROGRESS AND PEOPLE DRIVE AI.
LET’S BUILD SOMETHING INCREDIBLE — TOGETHER!”
